title: Mittag-Leffler passes to quotients and makes lim exact (Stacks 02N1 (2), (3))
statement: Let $0\to(A_i)\xrightarrow{(u_i)}(B_i)\xrightarrow{(v_i)}(C_i)\to0$ be a short exact sequence of inverse systems of abelian groups indexed by $i\ge1$ [def-weil-inverse-system]: $(u_i)$ and $(v_i)$ are morphisms of inverse systems (they commute with the transition maps) and $0\to A_i\xrightarrow{u_i}B_i\xrightarrow{v_i}C_i\to0$ is exact for every $i$. For an inverse system $(M_i)$ let $\varprojlim_iM_i=\{(x_i)\in\prod_iM_i:x_{i+1}\mapsto x_i\text{ for all }i\}$, so that $(v_i)$ induces $\varprojlim v_i:\varprojlim_iB_i\to\varprojlim_iC_i$, $(x_i)\mapsto(v_i(x_i))$. Then: (2) if $(B_i)$ is ML [def-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler-system], then $(C_i)$ is ML; (3) if $(A_i)$ is ML, then $\varprojlim v_i$ is surjective, so that $0\to\varprojlim_iA_i\to\varprojlim_iB_i\to\varprojlim_iC_i\to0$ is exact.
